sentences.text: Lost Highway is a 1997 French-American film written and directed by David Lynch .	David Lynch	David Lynch

It stars Bill Pullman as a man convicted of murdering his wife -LRB- Patricia Arquette -RRB- , after which he inexplicably morphs into a young mechanic and begins leading a new life .	Bill Pullman	Bill Pullman	Patricia Arquette	Patricia Arquette

The movie , which has noir elements , features the last film appearances of Robert Blake , Jack Nance , and Richard Pryor , and the acting debut of Marilyn Manson .	Robert Blake	Robert Blake (actor)	noir	film noir	Jack Nance	Jack Nance	Richard Pryor	Richard Pryor	Marilyn Manson	Marilyn Manson
Lynch co-wrote the screenplay with Barry Gifford , whose novel served as the basis for Lynch 's film Wild at Heart -LRB- 1990 -RRB- .	Barry Gifford	Barry Gifford	Wild at Heart	Wild at Heart (film)

Lynch conceived Lost Highway after the critical and box office failure of Twin Peaks : Fire Walk with Me -LRB- 1992 -RRB- , a film adaptation and follow-up to the cult television series Twin Peaks .	Twin Peaks	Twin Peaks
Despite receiving mixed reviews , Lost Highway has developed a cult following and is greatly admired by some critics .	cult following	Cult film
In 2003 , the film was adapted as an opera .	opera	Lost Highway (opera)
